import sqlite3
from decimal import Decimal, getcontext
import pandas as pd

# Set high precision for Decimal
getcontext().prec = 50

# Connect to database

    WHERE expected_revenue IS NOT NULL

print(sql_sum)

    print("\nComparison of first 20 decimal places:")
    print("SQL:", sql_str[:21])  # 20 decimals + decimal point
    print("Python:", py_str[:21])

compare_results(sql_sum, py_sum)

conn.close()
